title: 走进荣誉连廊。
method: Video + COLMAP + Brush Gaussian Splatting + approximate capture corridor

excludedCaptureRanges.note: Retain corridor and lounge; omit weak opening edge and final phone-booth approach from walking. All scoped registered images remain in splat training.

walk.limitations: Approximate capture corridor with local floor evidence, not a surveyed collision mesh. Reviewed level floors and junctions are recorded explicitly; walls can be under-observed.

scale: Estimated from camera height, not surveyed
author: 场景创建者提供的视频
quality: Requires visual and walk-through review; missing surfaces are not generated.
walkingRoute: Exact previously reviewed core route; added views train appearance, not expanded walking bounds.

notes: 起点回头的蓝色荣誉墙和卡座局部更清楚；侧看展柜、顶部和远处仍有模糊与重影。
从展示柜朝休闲区持续直行仍受原路线边界限制，当前版本没有开放新的直行范围。
